items.headline: Learning Agent delivers personalized in-the-flow learning through Work IQ
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's new Learning Agent, rolling out June 2026, provides personalized skill development directly in workflow through Work IQ and AI Skills Navigator. items.headline: Agentforce Multi-Agent Orchestration reaches general availability
items.summary: Salesforce Summer '26 release, live June 15, brings Multi-Agent Orchestration to general availability. The feature enables multiple specialist AI agents to work together under a single orchestrator, providing customers one unified point of contact with shared context across all channels. Businesses can now deploy complex multi-step workflows where subagents coordinate automatically without requiring customers to repeat themselves or navigate between agents.

items.headline: EY retracts cyber report littered with AI errors
items.summary: EY retracted a cybersecurity report in May 2026 after researchers discovered that 16 of its 27 citations were completely fabricated by AI hallucinations. The study, titled Points of Attack on Uncovering Cyber Threats and Fraud in Loyalty Systems, had been used by EY Canada consultants to promote cybersecurity services. Research group GPTZero identified that the report cited a non-existent McKinsey study, mixed up key figures, and relied on sources that were either missing or irrelevant.

items.headline: EU AI Act transparency obligations apply from August 2, 2026
items.summary: The EU AI Act's Article 50 transparency obligations take effect August 2, 2026, requiring companies to disclose when users interact with AI systems, mark AI-generated content, and inform users about emotion recognition or biometric categorization. The obligations apply to any AI system used in these four scenarios, not just high-risk systems. A grace period extends watermarking requirements until December 2, 2026 for systems placed on the market before August 2.
